claims.statement: Original HealthCheckLogic design in commit 1ea8d1f8 iterates DB_LIST and delegates connection status strictly to this.mainProcess.isDbConnected(alias) without alias-specific branching or model ping calls. MainProcess.isDbConnected(alias) in data-transfers/main-process.ts checks Mongoose readyState === 1 or connection truthiness, and can polymorphically inspect pg.Pool.ended without leaking Postgres or TransHisPgModel knowledge into HealthCheckLogic.
